clips.text: Nairobi, Kenya. Wanjiru runs a pharmaceutical distribution company.
Her registration is stuck. The regulator wants one document: the C-O-P-P.
What is a C-O-P-P? A Certificate of Pharmaceutical Product, in the W-H-O format.
It is issued by the national authority of the exporting country… not by the seller.
Her old supplier? Three weeks… no answer.
With Akuma Pharma, our team in India requests it from the manufacturer for you… and checks it.
Documents ready. Wanjiru can plan again.
Need documents for your next registration? Send us the product name on WhatsApp.
Akuma Pharma… closer than you think.
